questions.key_step: Integrate in $y$: $\int_0^1\left(\frac1{1+y^2}-\frac{y^2}2\right)dy$ with symmetry.
questions.justification: Direct area with one arctan integral; only the choice of $y$-strips needs thought.

questions.key_step: Spot the rectangle formed by four lines and subtract the piece cut off by the parabola.
questions.justification: Three-constraint region with modulus lines and a parabola; geometry plus one integral and a careful picture.

questions.key_step: Disc minus the lens $|y|\le1-x^2$; quarter-disc area minus $\int_0^1(1-x^2)dx$.
questions.justification: Routine area with circle and a modulus curve; coefficient comparison with $\pi$.

questions.key_step: Cubic $2x^3-3x^2-x+1=0$ factors; integrate parabola minus hyperbola and simplify surds.
questions.justification: Short idea but long exact surd and logarithm arithmetic where one slip changes $\ell,m,n$; options help.

questions.key_step: Write $x|x|$ and $x-|x|$ piecewise; only $x<0$ encloses area.
questions.justification: Two modulus functions to read piecewise, then a one-line integral.

questions.key_step: Split at $x=3$ where the lines meet; integrate with $x^{3/2}$.
questions.justification: Three boundaries, fractional powers and the cancelling $\sqrt3$ terms; routine chain.

questions.key_step: Integrate $\frac1x-\frac a{x^2}$ on $[1,2]$; area linear in $a$.
questions.justification: Single standard integral and a linear equation in $a$.

questions.key_step: Intersect at $(1,\pm2)$; integrate $\sqrt{5-y^2}-\frac{y^2}4$ in $y$.
questions.justification: Standard circle-parabola area with the $\sin^{-1}$ integral; options present.

questions.key_step: Wavy curve fixes which half-strip is kept at each $x$; width is $2\sqrt x$.
questions.justification: Needs reading the sign scheme of a rational expression to see the region; then easy integrals.

questions.key_step: Rewrite as $y=\frac{16}{x+4}$; intersect at $x=-2,4$; log integral.
questions.justification: Standard hyperbola-line area; log arithmetic with options.

questions.key_step: Two symmetric pieces: quarter disc minus $\int_0^2\sqrt{2y}\,dy$.
questions.justification: Circle-parabola region 'outside the parabola'; recognising the quarter disc is the only step.

questions.key_step: Tangent $y=3x+2$ and double root gives $Q(2,8)$; one cubic integral.
questions.justification: Tangent plus a single polynomial integral; the most direct item of the paper.

questions.key_step: Split at the crossings $\frac\pi4,-\frac{3\pi}4$ and at zeros; add absolute values.
questions.justification: Careful piecewise trig integration; signs of the pieces need attention.

questions.key_step: Same cubic factorisation and surd arithmetic as Q4 (the question is printed again).
questions.justification: Repeat of Q4: short idea, long exact arithmetic with surds and logarithm.

questions.key_step: $|4-x^2|\le y\iff4-y\le x^2\le4+y$; switch lower boundary at $y=2$.
questions.justification: Modulus inequality turned into a region with three pieces and surd arithmetic; numerical answer, no options.

questions.key_step: Find crossings $x=0,1,3$ of $|x|$ and $x|x-2|$; integrate the four pieces.
questions.justification: Maximum of two modulus functions with four pieces; exact integrals needed, no options.

questions.key_step: Recognise that the bounded piece is below the $x$-axis; add triangle and parabolic piece.
questions.justification: Region with two components and an unbounded part; deciding which piece is meant is the hurdle.

questions.key_step: Continuity and derivative match give $a=2$, $b=-12$; split the area at $x=1$.
questions.justification: Two concepts in sequence (differentiability then area) with surd arithmetic; numerical.

questions.key_step: Intersect circle and V at $(-3,4),(4,3)$; $25\pi-\int(\sqrt{25-x^2}-|x-1|)\,dx$.
questions.justification: Circle and modulus line with the $\sin^{-1}$ integral and a decision about the larger portion; numerical.

questions.key_step: $\min$ is $\cos$ outside $\left(-\frac{3\pi}4,\frac\pi4\right)$, $\sin$ inside; five signed pieces.
questions.justification: Same piecewise trig integration as Q13 with one more sign change; numerical answer.
